title: p0331
universal_lens: Will and belief form a physiological isomorphism: a single operator Ψ mapping (object, self) → relation, with indeterminacy σ coupling volitional and doxastic degrees of freedom. Habit-emotion knitting H acts as a low-pass filter converting instantaneous conversions C into stable attractors.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats Ψ as a conformal predictor: belief-state b_t = Ψ(o_t, s_t) + ε_t where ε_t ∼ N(0, σ²) shares volatility with volition v_t. Calibration requires σ(b) = σ(v) and non-conformity scores invariant under H-filtering of conversion events C.
gse_mapping: GSE models Ψ as a state-transition kernel: s_{t+1} = Φ(s_t, o_t; θ) where θ encodes physiological constraints. Instantaneous conversions C are Poisson jumps with rate λ; habit H integrates jumps into persistent policy π. Breakdown when λ ≫ 1/τ_H (conversion rate exceeds habit time-constant).

primitives.name: Will-Belief Isomorphism Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Will and Belief, in short, meaning a certain relation between objects and the Self, are two names for one and the same PsYcHOLoGICAL phenomenon.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Ψ: isomorphism operator (dimensionless); O: object space (dimensionless); S: self-state space (dimensionless); R: relation space (dimensionless); H: Hilbert space of physiological states (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Physiological substrate H is shared; mapping is bijective on support; no exogenous psychological primitives.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When physiological coupling γ → 0 (decoupled will/belief pathways) or when |O|, |S| → ∞ (combinatorial explosion).

layer2.mapping: GSI: Ψ defines joint conformal region C_α = {(b,v): |b - v| ≤ q_α(σ)}. GSE: Ψ is transition kernel Φ(s'|s,o) = δ(s' - Ψ(o,s)).
layer2.telemetry: Cross-correlation ρ(b_t, v_t) → 1; conformal coverage 1-α; transition entropy H[Φ] minimized.

primitives.name: Physiological Grounding Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Its roots, however, do not lie in psychology, but in physiology; as the chapter on Volition will abundantly make plain.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Γ: grounding operator (dimensionless); P: psychological phenomenon space (dimensionless); H: physiological state space (dimensionless); L_phys: physiological Liouvillian (s⁻¹)
primitives.assumptions: Psychology supervenes on physiology; Liouvillian L_phys generates deterministic flow; no downward causation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When τ_psych ≪ τ_phys (psychological timescales faster than physiological) or when L_phys has degenerate spectrum.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Γ induces prior p(θ|phys) for conformal calibration. GSE: Γ defines state-space embedding φ: S → H with metric g_ij = ∂_i Γ^k ∂_j Γ^k.
layer2.telemetry: Prior predictive checks; embedding distortion ‖g - g_true‖_F; Lyapunov exponents of L_phys.

primitives.name: Indeterminacy Coupling
primitives.verbatim_quote: If our wills are indeterminate, so must our beliefs be, etc.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: σ_W: volitional indeterminacy (dimensionless); σ_B: doxastic indeterminacy (dimensionless); ρ_WB: coupling correlation (dimensionless, [-1,1])
primitives.assumptions: Shared noise source; equal marginal variances; stationary coupling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ρ_WB → 0 (decoupled noise) or σ → ∞ (unbounded indeterminacy).

layer2.mapping: GSI: Shared σ defines joint prediction interval width. GSE: σ sets exploration temperature in policy π(a|s) ∝ exp(Q/σ).
layer2.telemetry: Empirical σ_W, σ_B, ρ_WB; prediction interval coverage; policy entropy H[π].

primitives.name: Conversion Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: Nature sometimes, and indeed not very infrequently, produces instantaneous conversions for us.
primitives.latex: C_t \sim \text{Poisson}(\lambda), \quad \Delta b = \kappa \cdot \mathbb{1}_{C_t=1}, \quad H_t = \int_0^t e^{-(t-\tau)/\tau_H} \Delta b_\tau d\tau
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C_t: conversion event count (dimensionless); λ: conversion rate (s⁻¹); κ: belief jump magnitude (dimensionless); H_t: habit-emotion state (dimensionless); τ_H: habit time-constant (s)
primitives.assumptions: Conversions are exogenous Poisson jumps; habit integrates jumps exponentially; κ constant.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When λ τ_H ≫ 1 (conversions faster than habit integration) or κ → 0 (vanishing jump impact).

layer2.mapping: GSI: C_t are non-conformity spikes; H_t defines adaptive calibration window. GSE: C_t trigger policy reset; H_t is eligibility trace.
layer2.telemetry: Jump detection F1-score; habit time-constant τ_H estimate; policy regret after conversion.

reasoning_traces.think:
The text establishes a physiological isomorphism Ψ between will and belief (quotes 1-4). This is formalized as a shared operator on object-self pairs with identical indeterminacy σ (quote 5). The first act of free will is believing in free will (quote 6), a fixed-point condition Ψ(o_fw, s) = s. Belief as emotional reaction (quote 7) suggests Ψ is nonlinear: Ψ(o,s) = σ(⟨o,s⟩_H + η) where η ∼ N(0,σ²). Instantaneous conversions (quotes 8-12) are Poisson jumps C_t with rate λ, producing belief updates Δb = κ that bypass volition. Habit-emotion knitting (quote 13) is a low-pass filter H_t = ∫ e^{-(t-τ)/τ_H} Δb_τ dτ converting jumps into stable attractors. Breakdown occurs when λτ_H ≫ 1 (conversions overwhelm habit) or γ → 0 (physiological decoupling). The GSE mapping uses Ψ as transition kernel Φ; GSI uses shared σ for joint conformal prediction. Cross-layer veto requires ρ_WB > 0.5 and λτ_H < 0.1 to prevent leakage between volitional and doxastic channels.
